I have been living on this island for what I think has been a year and a half. The ship I was on crashed into the rocky shore and I would have died if it wasn’t for a jackalope who saved me. (Played by <@!292531828592738304> ) Because of them, I was the sole survivor. We quickly became friends, I taught them common, while they helped me build my new home here. The uru took care of any bodies that washed up, and I collected things from the wreck, anything I could get. As I salvaged what I could, I remember being followed by a raven. Soon I realized it was the Raven Queen watching over me and I became her devout follower. While death brought me to this island, she helped me preserve my life. I'm interested in these newcomers, they seem to be from Europe like me. I didn’t talk to a lot of the natives here, I know a few, but I kept to myself mostly while I mourned my fellow passengers aboard that ship. It will be interesting to see who these people are, and what they are like. It has been quite some time since I have been in their society, the people here were kind and helped me, but I always missed home when I was with them. Maybe these newcomers brought a piece of my home here.
